name: mcode_build
description: Run a long build command in the background inside the sprite (rebuild/compile), polling until it finishes (up to 10 min). Returns a run { id, status, exit_code, output }. Use for e.g. 'cargo build', 'npm run build'. Requires write scope.

cmd.description: Build command, e.g. 'cargo build' or 'npm run build'.
